capabilities: Classify candidate values for tags and other frontmatter fields with per-candidate probability decisions
Generate new tags only for the tags field when explicitly enabled, using a chat model
Fetch frontmatter for a whole note or a single field from the command palette
Preserve field instructions, count limits, overwrite/append and WikiLink options and unrelated note text
Record token counts and response times per provider in a local usage file
extras: Sends note body, instructions and candidate values to the selected AI provider; stores local usage records (tokens, response times) per provider; states telemetry is none and that offline tests do not certify live-account or mobile behavior.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to select or fill frontmatter field values automatically, so users must tag and complete properties by hand.

relations.evidence: Classification uses decision API models only: TypeSafe Jev, OpenAI Decisions, OpenRouter or a custom /systemone endpoint.
Local Ollama and LM Studio can be keyless.

requires.name: provider API key (TypeSafe, OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, OpenRouter, DeepSeek)
provider account (OpenAI Codex OAuth, provider billing)
Ollama or LM Studio for local keyless use

summary: AI plugin that classifies and applies frontmatter metadata, such as tags, to notes using decision API models with per-value confidence.
